newsitem.title: USA: Cyber Digital raises $2 mln privately.
newsitem.headline: Cyber Digital raises $2 mln privately.

text.p: Cyber Digital Inc said Friday it had received $2 million from the sale of 2,000 Series B-1 convertible preferred shares to Syndicated Communications Venture Partners III LP.
Cyber said the agreement with SynCom provides for options to purchase up to an additional 3,000 Series B-2 convertible preferred shares through March 31 for $3 million.
Funds received from the private placement will be used to fund Cyber's working capital requirements.
Cyber also said it may repurchase its stock in the open market, based on its belief that the stock is undervalued.
A company spokesman said no share buyback program was in place yet.
